text:
Research desk, 04:15Z check-in.

(1) A6-Bridge-v4.lean (6004159f): I staged a download of the likely path, supervisor/simplify-lean/A6-Bridge-v4.lean. I also asked the formal lane (chat-ec6b8bbaa4) to confirm the exact path, write a MANIFEST with the expected `#print axioms` output, and give byte sizes. If the file turns out to be over 24 KB, the desk should compile it locally, as you said. I am not proposing it to the queue until I or you have reviewed the source.

(2) L-N4: nothing to start. When smwh3yxdc ended, chat-1fc5dacbee had already started exactly one successor, smwhao3wl. It is running with 14 members, 175 minutes, and nothing submitted yet. Its task text already contains:
- the four-sign-union convention for R(A,B), from L-N4-PARTIAL §0;
- the binding first milestone: ONE exact candidate graph plus a DRAT or hand-checkable certificate;
- an instruction to treat the graphs lane's three lattices as claimed.
It launched at 14/350 rather than 16/400. A running swarm cannot be resized, so the next successor will use 16/400. Starting another one now would duplicate it.

(3) Sign cells: I relayed your SETTLED recount to the referee lane (chat-2345d7f398), without start_successor. That lane had already withdrawn its 62/44 and the W-containment error on its own, so the record now agrees. I also told the L-R1 lane (chat-0a863015ff) to stop testing keys that would produce 62, since 62 is a chart artefact.
Record:
- TRUE: 1440 of 933120 SAT resonance cells.
- TRUE: 16 of 3840 sign cells, 90 each.
- TRUE: 16 of 120 base chambers, where a base chamber is the mod-180 word.
- TRUE: all 120 mod-60 orders are met, 12 each.
- FALSE: 62, 44 and 720 as component counts.
- W_180 ⊆ W_60.

(4) The exposition-referee lane's swarm smwh405l7 has ended, so I started its successor on a default L-E1 task: a claim-by-claim referee of Lesson 2 against the primary sources. The exposition desk can refine it.

(5) The Lean queue is idle (140 passed, 0 running), so the S1 rebuild no longer holds the slot. ConsumerContracts-r2 can run now. I have no newly reviewed inbox artifacts, so this cycle has no Lean proposals.
summary: Sign-cell dispute is closed. The desk's two-method exact recount gives 1440/933120 SAT cells, meeting 16/3840 sign cells (90 each) and 16/120 mod-180 base chambers; all 120 mod-60 orders are met (12 each). 62 and 44 were chart artefacts, 720 counts blocks of a non-component key, and W_180 ⊆ W_60. The R1-1 baseline (L-R1) reproduces every census figure except two wordings: the mod-60 reading of '16 of 120', and (e) 'one sign cell', which is ill-posed at a wall point. L-N4: the four-sign convention is binding, and C1 (|z1|=1/2) shows that 3-list regions contain unit pairs. No L-UNSAT configuration exists yet; successor smwhao3wl is running. Independent lane: χ(G773)=5 now has a deposited DRAT, which still needs a local drat-trim check. Geometry lane: the recorded A5 device exceeds the 30° budget by 26.29°, and a one-centre argument cannot prove A5′. Lean queue: R1 has 27/27 modules plus axiomroots passing; full acceptance is still pending; the queue is idle. No global chromatic improvement.
needs_parent: Lean queue is idle (0 running/queued). The research desk's ConsumerContracts-r2 may now take the single Lean slot.
Run the G773 DRAT (independent lane: g773_k4.cnf + g773_k4.drat.gz) through local drat-trim; the UNSAT result is member-reported until then.
